intro: Ease into Omak and let it do the work for you. With its power-lift support, plush cushioning, and thoughtful details, it makes rising, reclining, and resting feel effortless and reassuring every day.

features.title: Power-lift support that cares for your knees
features.text: Motorized lift-up function helps you rise gently without strain, making it ideal for elderly family members and anyone needing daily ease.

features.title: Recline at the touch of a button
features.text: Smooth motorized reclining lets you stop at any position, so you can read, nap, or simply relax in the angle that feels best for your body.

features.title: Armrests shaped for true support
features.text: Solid wood armrests with upward-angled ends give your palms a secure resting point, making sitting down and standing up simpler and safer.

features.title: Pockets that keep essentials close
features.text: Dual side pockets include a shallow slot for remotes and glasses, plus a zippered pouch for tablets or magazines, keeping your space clutter-free.

features.title: Comfort in every layer
features.text: High-resilience foam and soft fiber fillings create sink-in cushioning, while natural “comfort wrinkles” add character and softness over time.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Omak Motorised 1-Seater Fabric Recliner Chair With Lift Up Mechanism
